raw_key_storage_scope: Public raw keys only; excludes relinearization/public key, headers, formatted controls and runtime ciphertext memory.
limitations: No v2 encrypted row-norm, full attention, FFN or full-model result.
Historical measured RowLayerNorm used different inverse coefficients; this wrapper fixes the frozen v2 manifest.
Each valid variance must lie within its declared site interval; no ciphertext range inspection or clipping.
Actual binary64 metadata prediction excludes CKKS encoding, rescale, key-switch and propagated error.
No implicit refresh or codec; caller owns context, input compaction and final model/file-stage contract.
Input scale must be within existing1e-12 HEAdd compatibility of canonical scale; metadata is never reassigned.
